1.note: במ"ר read as 'in the Midrash Rabbah'; the sons of Ptolemy, Monobaz and Zotos, appear in Genesis Rabbah 46.

2.note: Hillel's disciples are in Bava Batra 134a; printed קל"ט (139), kept as printed.

3.note: No tractate is named. The saying is found in Yerushalmi Pe'ah 7:5 (also Ma'aser Sheni 5:2, Yevamot 7:2); the chapter letter in the print is unclear (ז or ו).

4.note: "Do not judge your fellow until you reach his place" is Avot 2:4 in the usual numbering; the print has ch. 1.

5.note: The skull saying is Avot 2:6 in the usual numbering; the print has ch. 1.

6.note: "Do not separate yourself from the community" is Avot 2:4 in the usual numbering; the print has ch. 3.

7.note: The story of the proselyte who would accept only the Written Torah is in Shabbat 31a; the print has 30b.

8.note: Literal rendering of the Talmudic phrase ("went out against his face"); its sense is obscure, perhaps that he went out in open opposition.

9.note: Printed כ"ב; read ב"ב (Bava Batra), whose story of Jonathan ben Uzziel and Shammai the footnote cites (Bava Batra 133b–134a).

10.note: Abbreviation not resolved; it names an authority (perhaps a commentator on Avot) who ascribes these sayings to Hillel the Elder.

11.note: "More flesh, more worms" is Avot 2:7 in the usual numbering; the print has mishnah 5.

12.note: Letters as printed; probably Zunz's *Die gottesdienstlichen Vorträge* (G. V.), with no page or chapter number after פ.
